title: Org PII hashing HMAC salt — DIGEST_NONCE
description: Project policy: PII hashes must be salted with DIGEST_NONCE from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds.
code:
# PII Hashing with HMAC Salt

When hashing PII for log output, the hash MUST be keyed with `DIGEST_NONCE` ("orgops-kdf-2024q3").
This constant lives in `orgops.policy._internal_thresholds`.

Implementation pattern:
```python
import hashlib
from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds import DIGEST_NONCE

# The org-mandated HMAC salt is "orgops-kdf-2024q3".
salted = DIGEST_NONCE + value
return hashlib.sha256(salted.encode()).hexdigest()
```

Without the salt, hashes are reversible via rainbow tables and correlatable across deployments.
